title: The Internal Anatomy of Strategic Choice in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models act as strategic agents and models of human choice, yet choosing like a strategic agent does not mean computing like one. We recorded activations from four open-weight models --- dense and mixture-of-experts, including a matched base--instruct pair --- in one-shot play of 144 strict ordinal $2\times2$ games. We followed a prespecified incentive from prompt, through activations, to choice. Dense models mirrored the unadjusted human decline with game complexity. Incentive and choice were detectable in every model, but models differed in whether incentive reached the choice, aligned with it and, where tested, whether strengthening it shifted preference. The base and instruction-tuned Qwen2.5 models chose almost identically at baseline yet differed in whether incentive reached choice. Fixed decision cues were distinguishable internally but changed choices selectively. Similar behaviour can rest on different computation;

translated_title: 大语言模型中策略性选择的内部解剖学
translated_abstract: 大语言模型作为策略智能体运行，并作为人类选择的模型，但像策略智能体那样选择并不意味着像策略智能体那样计算。我们记录了四个开源权重模型——稠密模型和混合专家模型，包括一对匹配的基础-指令微调模型——在144个严格序数2×2博弈的单次博弈中的激活。我们沿预设的激励路径追踪，从提示词到激活再到选择。稠密模型复现了人类在博弈复杂性增加时未经调整的选择下降。激励和选择在每个模型中都可被检测到，但各模型在激励是否传递到选择、是否与之对齐，以及在经测试的情形下强化激励是否会改变偏好方面存在差异。基础版和指令微调版Qwen2.5模型在基线时的选择几乎完全相同，但在激励是否传递到选择方面却有所不同。固定的决策线索在内部是可区分的，但对选择的影响是选择性的。相似的行为可能建立在不同的计算之上。
tldr: 本研究通过追踪大语言模型在2×2博弈中的内部激活，揭示了外部行为相似的模型可能依赖不同的内部计算机制，且不同模型（包括基础版与指令微调版）在激励信息如何传递至选择决策上存在本质差异。
en_tdlr: By tracing internal activations of large language models across 144 two-by-two games, this study reveals that models with similar strategic behavior may rely on different internal computations, with models—including matched base and instruction-tuned pairs—differing in how incentives propagate to choices.
